hero.title: Remember words longer, <accent>review right on time</accent> before you forget
hero.lead: Learn with cards and rate how well you remember each word. VocaSpace schedules the next review for every word, so your study time goes where you're still weak.
hero.factTrial: Many courses offer a free trial without signing in

how.title: Three steps to make a new word your own
how.step1Body: Each topic is a deck of cards with meanings, pronunciations and example sentences, written by teachers for your exam goals.
how.step2Body: After each card you pick a level. There's no right or wrong, just how well you remember.
how.step3Body: Hard words come back sooner and solid words spread out. Each day you only review the cards that are due.

highlights.title: Featured courses

teacher.title: Build courses from chapters and topics
